evals.name: stripe-webhook-setup
evals.prompt: i need to set up stripe webhooks for my side project. the endpoint is already deployed at api.roastlog.dev/webhooks/stripe and it handles checkout.session.completed and invoice.payment_failed. i've never done the stripe dashboard side of this though. can you give me the steps? i'm on my phone right now so anything that makes it easier would help
evals.expected_output: A published tap-to-copy checklist artifact with deep links into the Stripe dashboard, the signing secret handled as a value that must be pasted cleanly, and failure signatures named.
assertions: Deliverable is a self-contained HTML page, not only a chat reply or markdown file
Every command and pasteable value sits in a copy-to-clipboard block with a button
Copy blocks use white-space:pre so long values cannot soft-wrap into the copied text
Links target specific console pages rather than product homepages
Checklist progress persists to localStorage inside try/catch
At least one warning is placed inside the step where it fires, not only in a preamble
Names at least one concrete failure signature (symptom to cause)
Multi-command shell sequences are wrapped as a single paste (heredoc or one block)
States whether re-running a step is safe, or makes scripts idempotent
Prerequisites that could block the whole procedure are front-loaded before step 1 work
